Chat request with system message and user message

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "liter_llm"
api_key = ENV.fetch("API_KEY")
client = LiterLlm.create_client(api_key)
result = client.chat_async(LiterLlm::ChatCompletionRequest.new(messages: [{ 'content' => 'You are a helpful and concise assistant', 'role' => 'system' }, { 'content' => 'Hi', 'role' => 'user' }], model: 'gpt-4'))
puts result.choices[0].message.content.inspect
```
